## Description

A hollow spherical colony (~250 µm) with hundreds of biflagellate cells on its surface; it rolls
towards light. Daughter colonies grow inside and are born by breaking the mother.

## In the simulation

<!-- GENERATED:presence -->
Drops: `pond` (weight 0.3), `puddle` (weight 0.15); 2 individuals in a reference drop at weight 1.
<!-- /GENERATED -->

A [spherical colony](../../mechanics/stalks-and-colonies.md#other-colonies) with phototaxis that releases daughter
colonies.
